Brioche Hot Dog Buns
i wanted a hot dog and couldnt find buns so my best friend told me to make these from scratch hence began this 2 hour journey

Ingredients: 
350 grams maida
1 tbsp sugar
1 tsp active dry yeast
1 tsp salt
2 eggs
110 ml milk
55 grams butter, soft, at room tempreture

Method: 
combine flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a bowl, add in your eggs and room temp milk (it shouldnt be too hot or cold or your yeast goes bye bye)
kneed for 5 minutes then add in the butter and knead for another 5 mins
leave it to proof for 40-60 minutes till it doubles in size
take it out and divide into 6 equal portions
i rolled them the best i could, ideally roll to a cylinder and then roll them onto themselves
leave to proof for 30 mins on a tray, then add some egg wash sesame seeds and bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes or till done 
these keep well in the fridge for 2-3 days and can be warmed in a microwave to get them soft again
